$note: Extra locked palettes for world props and stations (docs/design/art-direction-study.md). Sampled with k-means from the style-locked art test 01 (tea-stall ocagi L1 and L2, island take 1) and rounded by hand. They extend design/tokens/pofu-tokens.json artPalettes for drift checks only; the app never reads them. Darkest allowed accent is wood-deep; nothing darker than ink-brown.

game-glazes.$note: The five recolor glazes of the garden minigame's plot tiles (batch 12 retry). A recolor asks for colors the props palette does not hold, so drift is measured against these. Body, shade and light per glaze, sampled (k-means) from the batch-12 takes and rounded by hand. A job adds it through `palettes:`.

character-tabby.$note: bagel-cart's honey tabby coat and coral neckerchief (batch 14 retry). The character palette is Pofu's peach; a honey-gold tabby with darker stripes sits outside it (drift failed at mean dE 4.0-4.4, off-palette 8-9%: #DD8844, #CC7733). Sampled (k-means) from the batch-14 takes' off-palette pixels and rounded by hand. A job adds it through `palettes:`.

paper-night.$note: The indigo-dyed night paper of ui-sheet-paper-night (retry 2026-11-04). The `night` palette has no dark navy, so the recolor drifted. Hand-picked: deep indigo paper, a lighter indigo lip, pale warm cream stitches. A job adds it through `palettes:`.
